baseline_models.focus_anchor: The motion of أقبل, the doubled بعض construction, and the reciprocal form يتلاومون.
baseline_models.mechanism: A collective breaks grammatically into portions, turns those portions face-to-face, and circulates reproach across the resulting opposition. Each party is positioned as both a blaming subject and another party's blamed object.

activation_trace.role: Literal face-to-face orientation supplies the spatial geometry through which reciprocal reproach travels.
Portions cut from a whole make the unnamed group appear as fragments set against other fragments.
Mutual reproach supplies the verbal exchange and makes blame circulate rather than move in only one direction.

changed_reading.after: The verse stages a reciprocal confrontation in which a once-collective body fragments into accusing and accused portions, with every face exposed to a counter-face.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: أقبل and بعضهم على بعض organize the agents into a closed relational circuit, while يتلاومون names contested blame.
baseline_models.mechanism: The facing relation can carry an undertaking or surety image: each portion turns toward another as though demanding that the other stand for a failed common act. Blame becomes an attempted transfer of liability around a circle that has no external recipient.

activation_trace.role: The undertaking and surety branch supplies a liability frame for the group's turning toward one another.
Apportioned pieces make responsibility divisible and therefore available for attempted reassignment.
Reciprocal blame is the speech act by which each portion contests or transfers responsibility.

changed_reading.before: The men quarrel after their loss.
changed_reading.after: Their quarrel functions like an improvised liability hearing: every member seeks another surety for a failure that remains jointly enclosed among them.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The packet gives a lingering or delaying branch for the same root and form-space as يتلاومون, while أقبل and بعضهم على بعض hold the parties in mutual orientation.
baseline_models.mechanism: Alongside audible blame, the group may be pictured as tarrying in a face-to-face impasse. The reciprocal scene does not advance action; it suspends each portion before another, making delay an embodied effect of accusation.

activation_trace.role: Mutual facing fixes the bodies in an opposed arrangement rather than carrying them onward.
The repeated portions distribute the stoppage across the whole group.
The literal possibility of lingering or slow delay supplies a simultaneous temporal undertone to the reciprocal form.

changed_reading.before: يتلاومون reports only an exchange of blame.
changed_reading.after: The exchange may also be an arrested interval: they face one another, blame, and remain stalled inside the aftermath.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier cue of a hidden sound or movement betraying its owner and the parable's lowered speech activate a concealment-to-exposure reversal. Once the parties turn visibly toward one another, blame makes the covert compact identify its participants from within.

activation_trace.role: Visible face-to-face confrontation provides the exposure surface that replaces covert coordination.
Reciprocal reproach becomes the audible disclosure of what the group had kept among itself.
A concealed sound or movement that reveals its source supplies the packet's leak mechanism.
Lowered, secretive speech marks the group's plan as deliberately kept below public hearing before it breaks into blame.

structural_cues: The garden owners move while speaking low in 68:23, but 68:30 gives bodily turning and reciprocal speech.
The same closed group that concealed the plan becomes the audience against which each member speaks.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies hidden speech, self-betraying traces, visible facing, and blame; I infer a concealment-to-disclosure arrow. A live alternative is simple narrative contrast, with no claim that the earlier gossip cue describes these same actors.

changed_reading.before: The owners cease whispering and begin arguing.
changed_reading.after: Their mutual blame is the failure mode of secrecy: the concealed compact leaks by forcing its own members to expose one another face-to-face.

context_deltas.mechanism: The test does not merely precede the blame; its branch inventory makes testing reveal an interior condition and also carries the presentation of an excuse until blame is removed. The focus scene is therefore the human evidentiary phase of the trial, with each person exposing the group while trying to clear himself.

activation_trace.role: The surety frame makes face-to-face turning an inquiry into who will answer for the common act.
Blame supplies the charge-and-defense exchange through which the test's result becomes socially legible.
Testing that brings a condition into view makes the group's response evidence of what the event uncovered.
The non-dominant mapped branch of displaying an excuse to remove reproach gives each accusation a defensive function.

structural_cues: 68:17 labels the episode a test before narrating the owners' decisions and speech.
The focus verse shows only relations internal to the tested group; no outsider conducts their hearing.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies disclosure by testing, excuse-making that removes blame, surety, and mutual reproach; I infer that the trial externalizes itself as an internal hearing. Alternatively, the blame may be merely one revealed trait rather than the mechanism of revelation.

changed_reading.before: Mutual blame is one reaction after the test has ended.
changed_reading.after: Mutual blame completes the test's disclosure: each defense simultaneously gives evidence against the collective undertaking.

context_deltas.mechanism: A collectively borne oath and the explicit absence of exception make the actors jointly bound before the loss. In the focus verse, each grammatical portion attempts through blame to create a retrospective exception, releasing itself from the whole by assigning liability to another portion.

activation_trace.role: Surety and undertaking turn the face-to-face relation into a contest over who remains bound to the failed pledge.
Portions of one whole supply the units that now seek separate liability.
Mutual blame performs the attempted release by locating fault in a counterpart.
An oath distributed across its people supplies the original joint bond rather than an isolated promise.
Removing one item from a total supplies the exception operation that was absent in the plan and is attempted belatedly in blame.

structural_cues: The plural oath in 68:17 is immediately followed by their making no exception in 68:18.
The focus construction repeats 'part' on both sides of the relation rather than naming one leader as sole culprit.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a group oath, no exception, divisible portions, surety, and reciprocal blame; I infer an ex post attempt to except oneself from joint culpability. The live alternative is ordinary causal accusation without a legal or set-theoretic release mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Each owner blames another for the failed plan.
changed_reading.after: Each portion tries too late to become the exception that the collective plan had refused, but reciprocal blame keeps liability circulating inside the original bond.

context_deltas.mechanism: Cutting begins as the owners' intended operation on the crop, appears again as the garden's cut-off condition, and then propagates socially. The focus names the owners as portions while also retaining an image of joined parts facing one another: severance has entered the group without fully separating it.

activation_trace.role: Joined sections placed against one another make the owners resemble a damaged assembly whose pieces still meet.
Parting a whole into portions supplies the social result of the repeated cutting image.
Reproach is the force acting along the damaged joins between the group's portions.
Cutting and separation first supply the intended material action that the group plans together.
A severed or cut-off piece supplies the state of the ruined object before that part-structure appears in the owners.
The reiterated cutting identity keeps severance active in their self-conception immediately before discovery.

structural_cues: The same root marks intended cutting in 68:17 and 68:22 and the devastated result in 68:20.
After the material object is cut off, 68:30 renders its owners through the repeated grammar of portions.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated material severance, a cut-off piece, joined sections, and human portions; I infer that the cutting pattern recoils from crop into social bond. Alternatively, the portion-language may be ordinary distributive grammar with no material transfer.

changed_reading.before: The crop is destroyed, and its owners then quarrel.
changed_reading.after: The intended cutting rebounds: the ruined garden's part-structure is reproduced in a group cut into blaming portions that remain painfully joined face-to-face.

context_deltas.mechanism: Sleep or heedless stillness gives way to a morning state-change and then direct sight. These cues strengthen the delay branch in the focus: after reality becomes visible, the group can no longer continue its planned movement and remains held in a reciprocal aftershock.

activation_trace.role: Opposed facing gives the halted group a stable bodily arrangement.
Lingering and slow delay supply the temporal state produced by the shock.
Hiddenness and heedless inactivity establish the unperceiving state in which the reversal occurs.
Becoming or entering a new state marks an irreversible morning transition rather than routine clock time.
Direct vision and inward recognition provide the shock that arrests forward action.

structural_cues: The sequence moves from sleep during the event, to changed morning condition, to seeing, to reinterpretation, and finally to mutual facing.
Their purposeful outward movement before discovery has no outward action after 68:26.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies heedlessness, state-change, sight, facing, and tarrying; I infer that recognition arrests the group in an aftershock. A live alternative is that يتلاومون carries only blame here and that the delay branch contributes atmosphere rather than an additional event reading.

changed_reading.before: The owners recognize the loss and then exchange blame.
changed_reading.after: Recognition produces an arrested aftermath: their motion collapses into a face-to-face interval where blaming and lingering coexist.

context_deltas.mechanism: A just or central voice recalls the neglected norm; the group first admits a wrong placement or withholding, then passes through reciprocal accusation, and afterward names its conduct as crossing a limit. The focus is an adversarial diagnostic interval that sharpens a diffuse collective admission rather than simply undoing it.

activation_trace.role: The whole divides into examining portions so that different causal assignments can be voiced.
Mutual reproach performs the adversarial diagnosis between two collective self-descriptions.
Justice or excellence located at the center supplies a normative voice against which the others can assess themselves.
Putting something outside its proper place supplies the first broad collective diagnosis of their act.
Crossing the limit in disobedience supplies the more precise diagnosis reached after the blame exchange.

structural_cues: 68:29 and 68:31 are collective first-person admissions placed on either side of the focus verse.
The central member's remembered warning in 68:28 gives the exchange a prior norm and a dissenting witness.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a just center, misplacement, reciprocal reproach, and limit-crossing in this order; I infer that blame mediates a refinement of confession. Alternatively, 68:31 may merely intensify lament independently of the intervening accusations.

changed_reading.before: Their confession of wrongdoing relapses into unproductive infighting before confession resumes.
changed_reading.after: The infighting is also a rough diagnostic hearing that moves the group's language from generic wrong to recognized transgression of a boundary.

context_deltas.mechanism: The split mapped root contributes gathering scattered pieces, while the following context contributes substitution and directed desire. This permits a non-terminal reading of the focus: the accusatory loop briefly regathers the fragments into a shared 'we' capable of seeking replacement and redirecting desire.

activation_trace.role: A mutually facing group supplies a temporary collective enclosure even while its members oppose one another.
Scattered portions preserve the fracture that any subsequent reconstitution must overcome.
The non-dominant mapped image of gathering scattered things makes confrontation a possible rough reassembly, not only dissolution.
One thing standing in place of another supplies the group's newly imaginable future beyond the ruined object.
Desire turning toward or away supplies the directional exit from the closed human-facing loop.

structural_cues: The fragmented reciprocal construction of 68:30 is followed by collective 'we' speech in 68:31 and 68:32.
In 68:32 the group imagines substitution and explicitly directs desire beyond itself.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies scattered parts, a gathering branch, replacement, and directed desire; I infer that confrontation may help re-form a collective subject and open redirection. The live alternative is that hope begins despite unresolved blame, not because blame reassembled anything.

changed_reading.before: Mutual blame is the terminal fragmentation of the owners.
changed_reading.after: Mutual blame is an unstable loop that both fractures and regathers them, making the later collective redirection possible without erasing conflict.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the capacity-to-face branch of ق ب ل beside أقبل, where that branch is not the direct verbal sense. It remains anchored in the same focus root and in the movement from deliberate, capable agency to face-to-face reproach. Render it only as ironic root-play or a functional analogy, not as a replacement translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: أقبل turns the actors toward one another, and يتلاومون is the only capacity-like action left after their confident departure.

activation_trace.role: Capacity to face or withstand supplies the ironic measure of what their agency has become.
Mutual reproach is the diminished action into which their asserted power is discharged.
Purposeful aiming supplies the owners' concentrated intention before the reversal.
Effective power sufficient for action supplies the capability they believe they possess on departure.

changed_reading.before: They set out confidently, lose the crop, and then blame one another.
changed_reading.after: Their claimed power contracts into the bare capacity to face one another; agency survives only as accusation.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is branch-distant because the prayer-direction image is not the ordinary sense of أقبل. It remains worth carrying because physical orientation is explicit in the focus and is bracketed by worship language and later desire directed toward the Lord. Downstream prose should call it a spatial-ritual analogy, never claim that أقبل itself means prayer direction here.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The group turns toward human counterparts in 68:30 before its desire is stated as directed toward the Lord in 68:32.

activation_trace.role: A prayer-facing direction supplies the contained analogy of blame temporarily orienting the group toward human counterparts.
Reproach is what occupies this temporary horizontal orientation.
Worship through praise or prayer supplies the ritual-direction context immediately before the focus.
Directed desire supplies the later reorientation away from the closed circuit of human blame.

changed_reading.before: They face one another in blame and later hope in their Lord.
changed_reading.after: The blame circle acts as a temporary human-facing direction that must be broken before desire can be redirected toward the Lord.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This reading depends on the non-dominant ل م م mapping carried in the packet and personifies the test as a gathering force, so it is form-distant and should not displace the direct blame reading. It remains anchored through يتلاومون, the repeated portions, mutual group-facing, and the narrated test and visitation. Render it as a secondary structural image: calamity gathers by pressure even as blame divides.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus gathers grammatical portions into a mutually facing group at the point of blame.

activation_trace.role: A mutually facing group supplies the temporary social body assembled in the focus.
Separate portions supply the scattered material that the event presses back into encounter.
Gathering and joining scattered things supplies the non-dominant reassembly image within the blame form's mapped inventory.
A worldly calamity supplies the pressure under which the scattered owners are gathered.
A test that reveals condition gives the assembling pressure a diagnostic purpose.
A passing visitation supplies the external event that closes around the owners' shared object before they converge.

changed_reading.before: A calamity causes a previously united group to fragment into blame.
changed_reading.after: The calamity also acts as an assembler: it forces scattered portions into a temporary face-to-face body whose paradoxical cohesion is mutual blame.

strongest_changes: The collective oath and absent exception turn mutual blame into a belated attempt by each portion to except itself from joint liability.
Repeated cutting propagates from intended harvest and ruined garden into the owners' social bond, leaving joined fragments facing one another.
The test makes blame evidentiary: each attempted excuse reveals the condition of the whole group.
Placement between collective admissions of wrong and transgression makes blame a diagnostic refinement rather than only a relapse into faction.
The delay branch remains live beside reproach, so the focus can depict an aftershock stall as well as an argument.
summary.what_was_special: The doubled portion grammar activated material partition, legal exception, social severance, and rough reassembly at once. Split mappings for ل و م and ب ل و preserved two especially non-conservative readings: blame as tarrying or gathering, and testing as both disclosure and excuse-making. These coexist with, rather than replace, the direct reciprocal-blame reading.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether the tarrying branch is an audible lexical undertone in context or only a structurally apt resonance.
Whether surety and retrospective exception describe the actors' actual reasoning or a legal analogy generated by the branch network.
Whether mutual blame enables the later collective redirection or the later hope begins despite unresolved accusation.
The non-dominant ل م م activations are productive but form-distant and require explicit containment in prose.
